title: Get started
description: Use the full CSS/JavaScript entry points, or load foundation.css with selected CSS parts and import individual initializers. See the component guide for complete recipes and native HTML templates.

title: Design tokens
description: Mist whites, slate darks, and selective cyan highlights. Colors adapted from the QuantumBlack Design System, mapped to the timvw components.

title: Typography
description: System fonts, a comfortable reading rhythm, and monospace for code. No font downloads.

title: Buttons
description: Use buttons for actions and links for navigation. Keep one primary action per group.

title: Form controls
description: Keep labels visible. Connect help and error text with aria-describedby; use native validation where possible.

title: Checkboxes & radios
description: Use checkboxes for independent choices and radios for one choice from a named group.

title: Cards
description: Group related content. Give each card a descriptive heading and a specific link when needed.

title: Badges & notices
description: Pair color with clear text. Add role="status" to dynamically updated feedback, or role="alert" for urgent errors.

title: Tables
description: Use a caption and scoped headers. The surrounding region can scroll on narrow screens.

title: Navigation
description: Use a labeled navigation landmark. On separate pages, mark the current page with aria-current="page".

title: Accordions
description: Native details and summary work with keyboard, touch, and JavaScript disabled.

title: Tabs
description: Arrow keys change tabs; Home and End jump to the first and last. Without JavaScript, all sections stay readable.

title: Dialogs
description: The native modal contains keyboard focus and closes with Escape. Focus returns to the button that opened it.

title: Progress
description: Provide an accessible label and a visible value. Omit value for indeterminate progress.

title: Accessibility is part of the markup.
description: The components provide visible focus styles, native controls, and keyboard behavior for tabs and dialogs. Your content and integration still need testing.

title: Icons & button variants
description: Copy icons.svg and reference a symbol with SVG use. Icon-only actions need an accessible name.

title: Switches
description: Use a switch for an on/off preference. Native checkboxes retain keyboard and form behavior.

title: Segmented choices
description: Use native radios for one selection. Arrow keys move between options; Tab enters and leaves the group.

title: Theme picker
description: The reusable picker remembers light, dark, or system appearance. Multiple pickers stay synchronized.

title: Breadcrumbs & pagination
description: Use navigation landmarks and aria-current to mark the current location. These examples link to real example pages.

title: Empty states
description: Explain what is missing and give a useful next action.

title: Warning & information
description: Pair color with an icon and a clear message. Static notices do not need live-region announcements.

title: Richer native inputs
description: Use visible labels and native input types. Date/time and file controls retain the browser’s own picker.

title: Form validation
description: Submit an incomplete form to see linked errors. Errors clear as you correct the fields.

title: Action menus
description: Enter, Space, or Down opens the menu. Use Up/Down, Home/End, and typing to move; Escape returns focus.

title: Popovers
description: Use a nonmodal popover for supplementary content or a short group of controls. Outside click and Escape dismiss it.

title: Tooltips
description: Use for supplementary descriptions, never essential instructions or interactive content. Hover, focus, or tap reveals the tip.

title: Detail drawers
description: A drawer uses the same native modal dialog and opener behavior as our dialog component.

title: Toast notifications
description: Announce a completed action without interrupting the workflow. Every toast has a dismiss button.

title: Searchable, sortable tables
description: Filter, sort, select rows, and move between pages. Selection is preserved when a row is filtered out.

title: Application layout
description: A responsive header, navigation sidebar, and main area. The sidebar is always available without JavaScript.

title: Searchable selection
description: Single selection and multiple values, enhanced from native selects. Use arrows and Enter to choose; Escape closes the list.

title: Loading, empty, error, and retry
description: A region has one state at a time. This preview uses a short simulated delay; Retry returns to the loaded state.

title: Multi-step forms
description: Validate each step, preserve values when going back, and review before submitting. Without enhancement, all sections remain visible.

title: File selection and upload states
description: Choose or drop files, remove them, and try success and retry states. The upload preview is simulated: no files leave your browser.

title: Avatars, account menus, and grouped navigation
description: Name avatars for assistive technology. Initials remain visible when an image cannot load. Groups and navigation use ordinary HTML.

title: More useful tables
description: Choose visible columns and expand a row. Expanded details stay with their project when sorted, filtered, or paginated.

title: Simple, accessible charts
description: SVG charts scale with the page. Each chart has a title, a description, visible values, and an equivalent data table. These are illustrative values.

title: Guided project creation
description: Comboboxes, team selection, files, validation, and a review step.

title: Settings workspace
description: Save local preferences with native form controls.

title: Project list
description: Search, sort, filter, select, expand rows, and choose columns.

title: Dashboard
description: Metrics and upcoming work derived from local projects.

title: Website template
description: Hero, features, pricing, testimonial, FAQ, and footer patterns.

title: Component guide
description: Variants, states, keyboard behavior, import recipes and copyable HTML.

title: Selective imports & native templates
description: Load only the CSS and JavaScript needed for a reusable native dialog.

title: Component playground
description: Change a button, input, notice or card and copy its HTML.

title: Connected workflows
description: Asynchronous validation, inline editing, remote options and cancellation.

title: Dutch workspace
description: Translated component messages, page content, numbers and dates.

title: Article & documentation layout
description: Readable article, in-page contents, related navigation and a resource footer.

title: Reusable HTML tags
description: Register a native template once, then use custom tags with reactive text attributes and isolated IDs.
